included: all pair-years passing independent-reference and actual-gap QC but failing only the three-complete-prior-primary-year requirement
original_workflow: outside its validated support; report unknown without assigning zero risk
water_normalization: strictly preceding observed primary values; with fewer than thirty prior values use current visible primary values, never backup values
air: public NASA POWER T2M UTC daily forcing; automatically incorporated without a query cost
CSDI_global_time: retrospective old-source training; no real-time or fully prospective global claim
probability_selection: unchanged automatic old-only H30 CRPS rule; no Canadian errors used
reference_sensitivity: report all eligible backup references; predictions cached once per primary logger-year and reused
aggregation: pair-years, distinct primary logger-years and one dependent provincial resource are reported separately
downstream: fixed 18/20 C illustrative thresholds only; local historical-q90 undefined when complete history is absent
claims: actual short natural-gap records, not a risk certificate, long-gap confirmation or probability-model superiority claim
